cards.title: Winter storm warning
cards.text: The National Weather Service warns of heavy snow for New York City. Some staff can't make it in, and more people order in.
cards.sourceTitle: National Weather Service, New York NY office
cards.effectNote: estimate: effect sizes are game design values; agent 07 tunes balance

cards.title: Arctic cold snap
cards.text: Arctic air settles over the city and daytime highs stay near freezing. Fewer people stroll, but hot coffee sells.
cards.sourceTitle: NWS: Central Park daily maximum temperature normals
cards.effectNote: estimate: effect sizes are game design values; agent 07 tunes balance

cards.title: Heat emergency plan activated
cards.text: The city activates its heat emergency plan and opens cooling centers. Air conditioning runs all day and the midday rush thins out.

cards.effectNote: estimate: effect sizes are game design values; agent 07 tunes balance

cards.effectNote: estimate: effect sizes are game design values; agent 07 tunes balance

cards.title: First warm weekend of spring

cards.effectNote: estimate: effect sizes are game design values; agent 07 tunes balance

cards.title: Nor'easter on the way

cards.effectNote: estimate: effect sizes are game design values; agent 07 tunes balance

cards.title: Congestion toll surcharge
cards.text: Trucks entering Manhattan below 60th Street pay the congestion relief toll. Some suppliers pass it on with a delivery surcharge.

cards.effectNote: estimate: effect sizes are game design values; agent 07 tunes balance

cards.title: Summer Streets goes car-free
cards.text: Summer Streets closes {block} to cars for the morning. Walkers and cyclists stream past the shops.

cards.effectNote: estimate: effect sizes are game design values; agent 07 tunes balance

cards.title: Open Streets weekend
cards.text: {block} becomes a car-free Open Street for the weekend. A DOT study found businesses on open streets did better than nearby blocks with traffic.
cards.sourceTitle: NYC DOT: Streets for Recovery, economic impact of Open Streets
cards.effectNote: estimate: effect sizes are game design values; agent 07 tunes balance

cards.title: NYC Marathon day
cards.text: The New York City Marathon runs through all five boroughs. Crowds line the course, but many roads are closed to traffic.

cards.effectNote: estimate: effect sizes are game design values; agent 07 tunes balance

cards.effectNote: estimate: effect sizes are game design values; agent 07 tunes balance

cards.title: Fourth of July fireworks

cards.effectNote: estimate: effect sizes are game design values; agent 07 tunes balance

cards.title: Coffee bean prices jump
cards.text: Arabica coffee hit record prices in 2025, according to the World Bank. Your roaster raises wholesale bean prices.

cards.effectNote: estimate: effect sizes are game design values; agent 07 tunes balance

cards.title: Coffee prices ease
cards.text: The World Bank expects arabica prices to fall in 2026 after the 2025 spike. Roasters trim wholesale bean prices.
cards.sourceTitle: World Bank Data Blog: beverage prices moderate as coffee and cocoa supply recover
cards.effectNote: estimate: effect sizes are game design values; agent 07 tunes balance

cards.title: Milk costs more
cards.text: Global dairy prices rose 3% at the Global Dairy Trade auction on November 3, 2026. Milk for lattes costs more this month.

cards.effectNote: estimate: effect sizes are game design values; agent 07 tunes balance

cards.effectNote: estimate: effect sizes are game design values; agent 07 tunes balance

cards.title: Sugar prices rise

cards.effectNote: estimate: effect sizes are game design values; agent 07 tunes balance

cards.title: Food costs keep rising

cards.effectNote: estimate: effect sizes are game design values; agent 07 tunes balance

cards.effectNote: estimate: effect sizes are game design values; agent 07 tunes balance

cards.title: Fuel surcharge on deliveries

cards.title: Minimum wage is now $17.00
cards.text: New York City's minimum wage is $17.00 an hour from January 1, 2026. Payroll in the game already uses the new rate.
cards.sourceTitle: New York State Department of Labor: minimum wage
cards.effectNote: estimate: effect sizes are game design values; agent 07 tunes balance
cards.note: Informational: there is no wage effect target in EffectTarget; packs already use $17.00.

cards.title: Health inspections are unannounced
cards.text: The Health Department inspects restaurants unannounced at least once a year. A restaurant gets two chances to earn an A in each inspection cycle.

cards.title: Trash must go in lidded bins
cards.text: Since March 1, 2024, every NYC business must set out trash in bins with secure lids. Loose bags on the curb can bring a fine.
